title: Mongols destroy the Hungarian army at Mohi
summary: The Mongols under Batu and Subutai crushed the army of King Bela IV of Hungary by the Sajo River. Much of Hungary was then ravaged.
reason: Hungary had sheltered the Cumans fleeing the Mongols and stood in the path of their invasion of Europe.
significance: It was the Mongols' greatest victory in Europe and devastated the kingdom of Hungary.
place: Muhi, near the Sajo River, Hungary
